title: Independently audit lossless GL3 free-mixing normalization
body:
The free-mixing implication in #4211 is one link between its normalized rank-one-projector alphabet and the intended raw three-register model. This independently audits that implication, following the remaining-gap handoff in #4214, at source `ca0002008b497428f0b651501c4a220a9d2785e7`.

The all-length written proof and constructive converters preserve literal paid cost and chronological address labels over the full noncommutative group algebra. They retain the terminal scalar residual unless the augmentation-I target forces it to vanish. The independently frozen core includes all504 conjugacies/28 converse bases,672 raw plus196 converse symbolic cases and10 countercontrols. Separate source integration binds504 full rows/converse witnesses, the actual64-assignment selector and168 paid factors, plus the unchanged DIRECT_NINE endpoint through both raw constructions. Raw scalar interleaving is adapter-owned; the original source implements normalized paid steps only.

Task/overlap: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority7, `formal-interface-lemma`, scope **changed** from proof-assistant formalization to this bounded written/stdlib interface audit. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2102#discussioncomment-19079502). Fresh335 open/draft bodies and live2102/hub checked; broader history/code/Discussion coverage remains partial. #4214 checks support pruning, James Reed's earlier review checks finite pins/seals, and this audits the separate raw-to-normalized equivalence. No construction/search expansion.

Validation: four registered Python3.12 normal/optimized warning-strict commands pass locally, with complete typed receipts, unchanged source pins and a separate proof/code review. The original core freeze truthfully records Python3.9.6; current3.12 replay agrees byte for byte. Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gl3-free-mixing-normalization`.

This does not certify full CNF transition/endpoint/Tseitin equivalence, SAT/RUP, minimum nine, physical costs, a supplier or the multiplication theorem. No new κ; no selected-frontier change. Written/mechanical checks are not independent-human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Open next questions: README/TASK name exact full CNF equivalence and separately budgeted another-platform RUP replay as the next bounded tasks. These are needed before admitting the model lower bound; this normalization result does not supply either. A separate reviewer checked all2,048 literal assignments for the tiny scalar selector fragment; that is explicitly not the full compiler audit.

Credit Brian Ross's original strategy, direction, oversight and normalization argument with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; retain Hanson Sun's seed18 and Josie Elliston's length10/three-register lineage, James Reed's prior finite pin/seal review, #4214's separate support audit and original NOTICE/license. ToikY used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for the independent core, source-reusing integration and separate review. Classical conjugation and augmentation are not new general mathematics. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge requested.
